info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 27, 2024 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cave, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII 作為一家空白支票公司營運。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 9 月 27 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cave。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long PBR Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the ADR of PBR. The fund is an actively managed ETF. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in the Underlying Security and financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of PBR, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 槓桿股票 2 倍多頭 PBR 每日 ETF 尋求每日槓桿投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 PBR ADR 價格每日百分比變化的兩倍 (200%)。該基金是主動式管理ETF。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上用於投資目的的借款）投資於標的證券和具有經濟特徵的金融工具，這些金融工具結合起來提供 PBR 價格的 200% 每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Seres Therapeutics, Inc. engages in the development of biological drugs through microbiome therapeutics platform. Its product pipeline includes SER-109, SER-287, SER-301, and SER-401. The company was founded by Geoffrey von Maltzahn, David A. Berry, and Noubar B. Afeyan on October 18, 2010 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Seres Therapeutics, Inc.透過微生物組治療平台從事生物藥物的開發。其產品線包括SER-109、SER-287、SER-301和SER-401。該公司由 Geoffrey von Maltzahn、David A. Berry 和 Noubar B. Afeyan 於 2010 年 10 月 18 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Cardiff Oncology, Inc. is an oncology therapeutics company, which engages in the development of drugs that target mitosis for the treatment of various types of cancer. The firm is focused on developing onvansertib, a first-in-class, third-generation Polo-like Kinase 1 (PLK1) inhibitor, in combination with standard-of-care chemotherapy and targeted therapeutics. Its clinical programs include KRAS-Mutated Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (mCRC), Resistant Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC) and relapsed or refractory Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML). The company was founded by Gabriel M. Cerrone, L. David Tomei, Samuil Umansky, and Hovsep Melkonyan in 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.description_zh: Cardiff Oncology, Inc.是一家腫瘤治療公司，致力於開發針對有絲分裂的藥物，用於治療各種類型的癌症。該公司專注於開發 onvansertib，這是一種一流的第三代 Polo 樣激酶 1 (PLK1) 抑制劑，與標準護理化療和標靶治療相結合。其臨床項目包括 KRAS 突變的轉移性結直腸癌 (mCRC)、抗藥性轉移性去勢抵抗性前列腺癌 (mCRPC) 和復發或難治性急性髓系白血病 (AML)。該公司由 Gabriel M. Cerrone、L. David Tomei、Samuil Umansky 和 ​​Hovsep Melkonyan 於 1999 年創立，總部位於加利福尼亞州聖地亞哥。

info.description: Summit Therapeutics, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, that focuses on the discovery, development, and commercialization of patient, physician, caregiver, and societal-friendly medicinal therapies intended to improve quality of life, increase potential duration of life, and resolve serious unmet medical needs. The firm conducts clinical programs focusing on Clostridioides Difficile Infection (CDI). Its lead product, Ridinilazole, is an orally administered small molecule antibiotic that is in Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of CDI. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.

info.description: Cosmos Health, Inc. is a pharmaceutical company, which engages in the importation, exportation, distribution, and sale of pharmaceutical products. It is also involved in the research and development of its business units, and acquisition of pharmaceutical companies. The firm offers over-the-counter drugs, branded and generic medicines, and dietary and vitamin supplements. The company was founded on July 21, 2009 and is headquartered in Thessaloniki, Greece.
info.description_zh: Cosmos Health, Inc.是一家製藥公司，從事醫藥產品的進口、出口、分銷和銷售。它也參與其業務部門的研發以及製藥公司的收購。該公司提供非處方藥、品牌藥和仿製藥、膳食補充劑和維生素補充劑。該公司成立於2009年7月21日，總部位於希臘塞薩洛尼基。

info.description: Ulta Beauty, Inc. engages in the retail of beauty products. The firm also includes salon and e-commerce services. Its products include makeup, skin care, tools and brushes, fragrance, and bath and body. The company was founded on January 9, 1990 and is headquartered in Bolingbrook, IL.

info.description: Prothena Corp. Plc is a clinical-stage neuroscience company, which engages in the discovery and development of novel therapies to change the course of devastating diseases. The firm's clinical pipeline includes both wholly owned and partnered programs being developed for the potential treatment of diseases including AL amyloidosis, ATTR amyloidosis, Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded in December 1969 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.description_zh: Prothena Corp. Plc 是一家臨床階段的神經科學公司，致力於發現和開發新療法以改變破壞性疾病的進程。該公司的臨床管道包括正在開發的全資和合作項目，用於潛在治療 AL 澱粉樣變性、ATTR 澱粉樣變性、阿茲海默症、帕金森氏症和其他神經退化性疾病。該公司成立於1969年12月，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Direxion Daily META Bull 2X ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the daily performance of META. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of META and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that, in combination, provide 2X daily leveraged exposure to META, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily META Bull 2X ETF 尋求每日投資結果（未計費用和開支）為 META 每日表現的 200%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 META 證券和金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權，這些組合起來為 META 提供 2 倍的每日槓桿敞口，這與基金的投資目標一致。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.5x Long META Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.50 times (150%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A. The fund will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial Institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the fund and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return (or differentials in rates of return) earned or realized on the Underlying Stock.

info.description: MetaVia, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company, which engages in developing and commercializing multi-modal disease-modifying therapies. Its pipeline includes ANA001, a proprietary oral niclosamide formulation, Gemcabene, which is assessed as an acute indication for COVID-19, NB-01, a treatment for painful diabetic neuropathy, and NB-02, which has the potential to treat the symptoms of cognitive impairment and modify the progression of neurodegenerative diseases. The company was founded on October 30, 2014 and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: MetaVia, Inc.是一家臨床階段生物技術公司，致力於開發和商業化多模式疾病緩解療法。其產品線包括 ANA001（一種專有的口服氯硝柳胺製劑）、Gemcabene（被評估為 COVID-19 的急性適應症）、NB-01（一種治療疼痛性糖尿病神經病變的藥物）和 NB-02（有潛力治療認知障礙症狀並改變神經退化性疾病的進展）。該公司成立於2014年10月30日，總部位於麻薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: Quantum Cyber NV engages in assembling an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered, quantum-accelerated system-of-systems autonomous defense platform. It integrates drone warfare, counter-UAS, autonomous naval mine countermeasures, EMP shielding, anti-drone ammunition, command-and-control, and quantum antenna applications. The company was founded on March 8, 2021 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: Quantum Cyber​​ NV 致力於組裝由人工智慧 (AI) 驅動、量子加速的系統級系統自主防禦平台。它整合了無人機作戰、反無人機、自主水雷對抗、電磁脈衝屏蔽、反無人機彈藥、指揮控制和量子天線應用。該公司成立於 2021 年 3 月 8 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州西棕櫚灘。

info.description: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage, oncology-focused biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of conditionally activated, biologics localized to the tumor microenvironment. The company was founded by Frederick W. Gluck and Nancy E. Stagliano in September 2010 and is headquartered in South San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: CytomX Therapeutics, Inc.是一家專注於腫瘤學的臨床階段生物製藥公司，致力於開發針對腫瘤微環境的條件激活生物製劑。該公司由 Frederick W. Gluck 和 Nancy E. Stagliano 於 2010 年 9 月創立，總部位於加州南舊金山。

info.description: Meta Platforms, Inc. engages in the development of social media applications. It builds technology that helps people connect and share, find communities, and grow businesses. It operates through the Family of Apps (FoA) and Reality Labs (RL) segments. The FoA segment consists of Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and other services. The RL segment includes augmented, mixed and virtual reality related consumer hardware, software, and content. The company was founded by Mark Elliot Zuckerberg, Dustin Moskovitz, Chris R. Hughes, Andrew McCollum, and Eduardo P. Saverin on February 4, 2004, and is headquartered in Menlo Park, CA.

info.description: Defiance Oil Enhanced Options Income ETF seeks current income; secondary objective being exposure to the performance of United States Oil Fund, LP ("USO") subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund is an actively managed ETF that seeks current income while maintaining the opportunity for indirect exposure to the share price of United States Oil Fund, LP, subject to a limit on potential gains related to increases in the price of USO's shares. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Defiance Oil 增強型選擇權收益 ETF 尋求當前收益；次要目標是了解美國石油基金有限合夥人（「USO」）的業績，但受到潛在投資收益的限制。該基金是一種主動管理的 ETF，尋求當前收入，同時保持間接接觸 United States Oil Fund, LP 股價的機會，但受到與 USO 股價上漲相關的潛在收益的限制。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Cardinal Health, Inc. is a healthcare services and products company, which engages in the provision of customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. It also provides medical products and pharmaceuticals and cost-effective solutions that enhance supply chain efficiency. The firm operates through the Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment and Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment. The Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions Segment distributes branded and generic pharmaceutical, specialty pharmaceutical, and over-the-counter healthcare and consumer products in the United States. The Global Medical Products and Distribution Segment manufactures, sources, and distributes Cardinal Health brand medical, surgical, and laboratory products, which are sold in the United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, and other markets. The company was founded by Robert D. Walter in 1979 and is headquartered in Dublin, OH.
info.description_zh: Cardinal Health, Inc. 是一家醫療保健服務和產品公司，致力於為醫院、醫療保健系統、藥房、門診手術中心、臨床實驗室和醫師辦公室提供客製化解決方案。它還提供醫療產品和藥品以及具有成本效益的解決方案，以提高供應鏈效率。該公司透過製藥和專業解決方案部門以及全球醫療產品和分銷部門運營。製藥和專業解決方案部門在美國分銷品牌和仿製藥、專業藥品以及非處方醫療保健和消費品。全球醫療產品和分銷部門生產、採購和分銷 Cardinal Health 品牌的醫療、外科和實驗室產品，這些產品銷往美國、加拿大、歐洲、亞洲和其他市場。該公司由 Robert D. Walter 於 1979 年創立，總部位於俄亥俄州都柏林。

info.description: Digital Asset Debt Strategy ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation and, secondarily, income. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). Under normal market conditions the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in debt securities of issuers that are directly involved in digital asset-related activities. The digital asset-related activities that such issuers may be involved in include (i) mining of digital assets; (ii) holding digital assets in their corporate treasury or government treasury; and (iii) working on platforms to facilitate payment with, or the transfer of, digital assets.
info.description_zh: 數位資產債務策略ETF尋求長期資本增值，其次是收入。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。在正常市場條件下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產投資於直接參與數位資產相關活動的發行人的債務證券。此類發行人可能參與的數位資產相關活動包括（i）數位資產的挖礦； (ii) 在公司金庫或政府金庫中持有數位資產； (iii) 致力於開發促進數位資產支付或轉移的平台。

info.description: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. is a financial holding company, which engages in the provision of community banking services. It operates through the Banking and Consumer Finance segments. The firm also offers non-banking activities, such as securities underwriting and dealing activities, insurance agency and underwriting activities, and merchant banking and equity investment activities. The company was founded on January 8, 1992 and is headquartered in Gallipolis, OH.
info.description_zh: Ohio Valley Banc Corp. 是一家金融控股公司，從事提供社區銀行服務。它透過銀行和消費金融部門運作。該公司還提供非銀行業務，例如證券承銷和交易活動、保險代理和承銷活動以及商業銀行和股權投資活動。該公司成立於1992年1月8日，總部位於俄亥俄州加利波利斯。

info.description: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. engages in the production of oilseeds, corn, wheat, cocoa, and other agricultural commodities. It operates through the following segments: Ag Services and Oilseeds, Carbohydrate Solutions, Nutrition, and Other. The Ag Services and Oilseeds segment includes activities related to the origination, merchandising, transportation, and storage of agricultural raw materials, and the crushing and further processing of oilseeds such as soybeans and soft seeds cottonseed, sunflower seed, canola, rapeseed, and flaxseed into vegetable oils and protein meals. The Carbohydrate Solutions segment consists of corn and wheat wet and dry milling and other activities. The Nutrition segment serves various end markets including food, beverages, nutritional supplements, and feed and premix for livestock, aquaculture, and pet food. The Other segment refers to the company's remaining operations. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Chicago, IL.
info.description_zh: Archer-Daniels-Midland Co. 從事油籽、玉米、小麥、可可和其他農產品的生產。它透過以下部門運作：農業服務和油籽部門、碳水化合物解決方案部門、營養部門和其他部門。農業服務和油籽部門包括與農業原料的原產地、銷售、運輸和儲存有關的活動，以及將大豆和軟籽棉籽、葵花籽、油菜籽、油菜籽和亞麻籽等油籽壓榨和深加工成植物油和蛋白粉的活動。碳水化合物解決方案部門包括玉米和小麥的濕磨和乾磨以及其他活動。營養部門服務於各種終端市場，包括食品、飲料、營養補充劑以及牲畜、水產養殖和寵物食品的飼料和預混料。其他部門是指公司的剩餘業務。該公司成立於 1902 年，總部位於伊利諾伊州芝加哥。

info.description: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation by actively investing in equity securities of energy-related companies or instruments providing exposure to energy-related companies. The strategy targets full market capitalization representation across the energy sector to minimize tracking error and performance deviation relative to traditional broad sector benchmarks.
info.description_zh: VanEck Energy TruSector ETF 透過積極投資能源相關公司的股本證券或提供能源相關公司曝險的工具來尋求長期資本增值。該策略的目標是整個能源行業的完整市值代表性，以最大限度地減少相對於傳統廣泛行業基準的追蹤誤差和績效偏差。

info.description: Best Buy Co., Inc. engages in the provision of consumer technology products and services. It operates through two business segments: Domestic and International. The Domestic segment includes operations in all states and territories of the U.S., operating under various brand names, including Best Buy, Best Buy Mobile, Geek Squad, Magnolia Audio Video, and Pacific Sales. The International segment consists of operations in Canada. It also markets its products under the brand names: Best Buy, bestbuy.com, Best Buy Express, Lively, Geek Squad, Magnolia and Pacific Kitchen and Home. The company was founded by Richard M. Schulze in 1966 and is headquartered in Richfield, MN.
info.description_zh: Best Buy Co., Inc. 從事提供消費性科技產品和服務。它透過兩個業務部門運作：國內和國際。國內部門包括在美國所有州和地區的業務，以各種品牌運營，包括 Best Buy、Best Buy Mobile、Geek Squad、Magnolia Audio Video 和 Pacific Sales。國際部門包括加拿大的業務。它還以以下品牌銷售其產品：Best Buy、bestbuy.com、Best Buy Express、Lively、Geek Squad、Magnolia 和 Pacific Kitchen and Home。該公司由 Richard M. Schulze 於 1966 年創立，總部位於明尼蘇達州里奇菲爾德。

info.description: The Bank of New York Mellon Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of financial services. It operates through the following segments: Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other. The Securities Services segment includes the Asset Servicing business, which provides global custody, fund accounting, integrated middle-office solutions, transfer agency and data, and analytics solutions. The Market and Wealth Services segment consists of the Pershing, Clearance and Collateral Management, and Treasury Services businesses. The Investment and Wealth Management segment is involved in services to institutional and retail investors, as well as investment management, wealth, and estate planning. The Other segment refers to the leasing portfolio, corporate treasury activities, derivatives, and other trading activity. The company was founded by Alexander Hamilton on June 9, 1784 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

info.description: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of waste management solutions and services. It operates through the following segments: U.S. Concrete Pumping, U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services, and the U.K. Operations. The U.S. Concrete Pumping segment includes services under the Brundage-Bone and Capital Pumping trade names. The U.S. Concrete Waste Management Services segment is involved in the pans and containers rented to customers and the disposal services under the Eco-Pan trade name. The U.K. Operations segment relates to the concrete pumping services and leasing of concrete pumping equipment to customers under the Camfaud Concrete Pumps and Premier Concrete Pumping trade names. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Thornton, CO.
info.description_zh: Concrete Pumping Holdings, Inc. 從事提供廢棄物管理解決方案和服務。它透過以下部門運作：美國混凝土泵送部門、美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門和英國營運部門。美國混凝土泵送部門包括以 Brundage-Bone 和 Capital Pumping 商標名稱提供的服務。美國混凝土廢棄物管理服務部門提供向客戶出租的盤子和容器以及以 Eco-Pan 商標名稱提供的處置服務。英國營運部門涉及混凝土泵送服務以及以 Camfaud Concrete Pumps 和 Premier Concrete Pumping 商標名向客戶租賃混凝土泵送設備。該公司成立於 1983 年，總部位於科羅拉多州桑頓。

info.description: Belite Bio, Inc. engages in the research and development of drugs. It focuses on the treatment of eye diseases involving retinal degeneration such as atrophic age-related macular degeneration and autosomal recessive Stargardt disease. It also caters to metabolic diseases such as non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, nonalcoholic steatohepatitis, type 2 diabetes, and gout. The company was founded by Yu-Hsin Lin on March 27, 2018 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST Ether ETF is an actively managed fund that employs a synthetic income-generation strategy by selling put options on leveraged exchange-traded funds linked to the daily performance of Ether. info.description_zh: GraniteShares YieldBOOST 以太 ETF 是一檔主動式管理基金，透過出售與以太每日表現掛鉤的槓桿交易所交易基金看跌期權，採用合成創收策略。該基金力求實現參考資產的標準選擇權策略所產生的 200% 的收入，同時保持對基礎槓桿工具的曝險，儘管受到潛在資本增值上限的限制。

info.description: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the business of developing and commercializing novel therapeutics based on ribonucleic acid interference. The company was founded by Noble Laureate, David Bartel, Thomas Tuschl, Phillip Zamore, Paul R. Schimmel, and Phillip Allen Sharp on June 14, 2002, and is headquartered in Cambridge, MA.
info.description_zh: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, Inc.是一家生物製藥公司，從事基於核糖核酸幹擾的新型療法的開發和商業化業務。該公司由諾貝爾獎得主 David Bartel、Thomas Tuschl、Phillip Zamore、Paul R. Schimmel 和 Phillip Allen Sharp 於 2002 年 6 月 14 日創立，總部位於馬薩諸塞州劍橋。

info.description: GoDaddy, Inc. engages in the provision of simple and easy-to-use products on a single technology platform, complemented by personalized guidance. It operates through the following segments: Applications and Commerce (A&C) and Core Platform (Core). The Applications and Commerce (A&C) segment sells products containing proprietary software, commerce solutions, third-party email services, productivity tools, and certain products bundled with proprietary software offerings. The Core Platform (Core) segment provides domain registrations and renewals, aftermarket domain sales, website hosting services, website security products that are not included in bundled proprietary software offerings, and other products that do not contain a software component. The company was founded by Robert R. Parsons in 1997 and is headquartered in Tempe, AZ.
info.description_zh: GoDaddy, Inc. 致力於在單一技術平台上提供簡單易用的產品，並輔以個人化指導。它透過以下部門運作：應用程式和商務（A＆C）以及核心平台（Core）。應用程式和商務 (A&C) 部門銷售的產品包含專有軟體、商務解決方案、第三方電子郵件服務、生產力工具以及與專有軟體產品捆綁在一起的某些產品。核心平台（核心）部門提供網域名稱註冊和續約、售後網域銷售、網站寄存服務、不包含在捆綁專有軟體產品中的網站安全產品以及其他不包含軟體元件的產品。該公司由 Robert R. Parsons 於 1997 年創立，總部位於亞利桑那州坦佩。

info.description: Epsilon Energy Ltd. engages in the business of acquiring, developing, gathering, and producing natural gas and oil reserves. It operates through the following segments: Upstream, and Gathering System. The Upstream segment includes the acquisition, exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas reserves. The Gathering System segment deals with natural gas gathering system. The company was founded by Zoran Arandjelovic and John K. Wilson on March 14, 2005 and is headquartered in Houston, TX.
info.industry_zh: 石油和天然氣勘探與生產
info.description_zh: Epsilon Energy Ltd. 從事收購、開發、收集和生產天然氣和石油儲備的業務。它透過以下部分運作：上游和收集系統。上游部門包括石油和天然氣儲量的收購、勘探、開發和生產。收集系統部門涉及天然氣收集系統。該公司由 Zoran Arandjelovic 和 John K. Wilson 於 2005 年 3 月 14 日創立，總部位於德克薩斯州休士頓。

info.description: Varonis Systems, Inc. engages in the provision of a security software platform. Its software enables enterprises and industries to protect data stored in the cloud and on-premises including sensitive files and emails, confidential personal data belonging to customers, patients, and employees, financial records, source code, strategic, and product plans, and other intellectual property. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Europe, Middle East, and Africa, and Rest of the World. The company was founded by Yakov Faitelson and Ohad Korkus on November 3, 2004 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Varonis Systems, Inc. 從事提供安全軟體平台。其軟體使企業和行業能夠保護儲存在雲端和本地的數據，包括敏感文件和電子郵件、屬於客戶、患者和員工的機密個人資料、財務記錄、原始程式碼、策略和產品計劃以及其他智慧財產權。它透過以下地理區域開展業務：北美、歐洲、中東、非洲以及世界其他地區。該公司由 Yakov Faitelson 和 Ohad Korkus 於 2004 年 11 月 3 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: DLocal Ltd. engages in the business of simplifying and redefining online payments experience. It focuses on processing payment transactions which enables merchants to get paid from customers and to make payments to customers in emerging markets. The company was founded by Andres Bzurovski Bay and Sergio Enrique Fogel Kaplan in 2016 and is headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay.

info.description: Bunge Global SA engages in agribusiness including food and ingredients. It operates through the following segments: Agribusiness, Refined & Specialty Oils, Milling, Sugar & Bioenergy, and Corporate & Other. The Agribusiness segment is an integrated, global business principally involved in the purchase, storage, transportation, processing and sale of agricultural commodities and commodity products. The Refined & Specialty Oils segment includes businesses that sell vegetable oils and fats, including cooking oils, shortenings, specialty ingredients, and renewable diesel feedstocks. The Milling segment refers to the businesses that sell wheat flours, bakery mixes, and corn-based products. The Sugar & Bioenergy segment consists of results from the company's previously owned 50% ownership interest in BP Bunge Bioenergia. The Corporate & Other segment focuses on the salaries and overhead for corporate functions that are not allocated to individual reporting segments because the operating performance of such reporting segments is evaluated. It connects farmers to consumers to deliver essential and sustainable food, feed and fuel. The company was founded on February 14, 2023 and is headquartered in Chesterfield, MO.
info.description_zh: Bunge Global SA 從事農業綜合業務，包括食品和配料。它透過以下部門運作：農業綜合企業、精煉和特種油、製粉、糖和生物能源以及企業和其他部門。農業綜合企業部門是一家綜合性、全球性企業，主要涉及農產品和大宗商品的採購、儲存、運輸、加工和銷售。精煉和特種油部門包括銷售植物油和脂肪的業務，包括食用油、起酥油、特殊成分和再生柴油原料。製粉部門是指銷售小麥麵粉、烘焙混合物和玉米產品的業務。糖業和生質能源部門包括該公司先前擁有 BP Bunge Bioenergia 50% 股權的表現。公司及其他分部重點關注公司職能的薪資和間接費用，這些職能未分配給各個報告分部，因為要評估此類報告分部的經營業績。它將農民與消費者聯繫起來，提供基本且永續的食品、飼料和燃料。該公司成立於 2023 年 2 月 14 日，總部位於密蘇裡州切斯特菲爾德。

info.description: Apple, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and other varieties of related services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, and Rest of Asia Pacific. The Americas segment includes North and South America. The Europe segment consists of European countries, as well as India, the Middle East, and Africa. The Greater China segment comprises China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. The Rest of Asia Pacific segment includes Australia and Asian countries. Its products and services include iPhone, Mac, iPad, AirPods, Apple TV, Apple Watch, Beats products, AppleCare, iCloud, digital content stores, streaming, and licensing services. The company was founded by Steven Paul Jobs, Ronald Gerald Wayne, and Stephen G. Wozniak in April 1976 and is headquartered in Cupertino, CA.

info.description: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, which focuses on developing medicines to target diseases driven by abnormally elevated aldosterone. Its clinical-stage product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor that are initially developing for the treatment of cardiorenal conditions affected by abnormally elevated aldosterone, including hypertension and chronic kidney disease. The company was founded by Brian Taylor Slingsby on May 31, 2019 and is headquartered in Radnor, PA.
info.description_zh: Mineralys Therapeutics, Inc.是一家臨床階段的生物製藥公司，專注於開發針對由醛固酮異常升高引起的疾病的藥物。其臨床階段候選產品lorundrostat是一種專有的口服高選擇性醛固酮合成酶抑制劑，最初開發用於治療受醛固酮異常升高影響的心腎疾病，包括高血壓和慢性腎臟病。該公司由 Brian Taylor Slingsby 於 2019 年 5 月 31 日創立，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州拉德諾。

info.description: Tuniu Corp. is an online leisure travel company, which engages in the provision of travel-related services in China. It offers packaged tours, including organized tours and self-guided tours, and also travel-related services for leisure travelers. Its product portfolio includes organized tours, self-guided tours, and tickets for various domestic and overseas tourist attractions. The company was founded by Dunde Yu and Hai Feng Yan in 2006 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
info.description_zh: 途牛公司是一家線上休閒旅遊公司，在中國提供旅遊相關服務。它為休閒遊客提供跟團遊和自助遊等跟團遊以及旅遊相關服務。其產品組合包括跟團遊、自助遊以及國內外各個旅遊景點的門票。該公司由於敦德和嚴海峰於2006年創立，總部位於中國南京。

info.description: GraniteShares 1.75x Long AAPL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 1.75 times (175%) the daily percentage change of the common stock of Apple Inc. The fund is an actively managed etf that attempts to replicate 1.75 times (175%) the daily percentage change of the underlying stock by entering into a swap agreement on the underlying stock. The adviser will enter into one or more swap agreements with major financial institutions for a specified period ranging from a day to more than one year whereby the adviser and the financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the underlying stock. It is non-diversified.

The Trust functions as a transparent investment vehicle, holding Dogecoin in institutional-grade custody to allow investors to participate in the price movements of the cryptocurrency without the complexities of managing digital wallets or private keys.
info.description_zh: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF 是一種被動管理的交易所交易基金，提供直接、實物支持的數位資產狗狗幣 (DOGE) 曝險。該信託基金作為一種透明的投資工具，以機構級託管方式持有狗狗幣，使投資者能夠參與加密貨幣的價格變動，而無需管理數位錢包或私鑰的複雜性。

info.description: DAXOR Corporation is an innovative medical instrumentation and biotechnology company. DAXOR designed and developed the BVA-100 Blood Volume Analyzer. It is the first instrument approved by the FDA to provide rapid direct measurement of a patient's true blood volume. We believe that the BVA-100 Blood Volume Analyzer has the potential to transform therapy in a broad range of surgical and medical conditions. It is our goal, working in conjunction with hospitals and clinics, to achieve that possibility. The BVA-100 is a semi-automated Blood Volume Analyzer. It is used in conjunction with a single use diagnostic kit. It is the first FDA-approved instrument to provide rapid direct measurement of a patient's blood volume.

info.description: TDH Holdings, Inc. is a real estate management company, that focuses on owning, operating and managing commercial real estate properties. It provides office services for small and medium-sized enterprises. The company was founded by Rong Feng Cui on April 22, 2002 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: TDH Holdings, Inc. 是一家房地產管理公司，專注於擁有、經營和管理商業房地產。為中小企業提供辦公服務。該公司由崔榮峰於2002年4月22日創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: SL Science Holding Ltd. operates as a biomedical company. It operates through Exosome products, CD-19 Armed-T products, GDT cell therapy products, corporate and unallocated segments. The firm offers immune cell development, skincare product formulations, cellular and gene therapies. The company was founded by Ching Dong Wang on March 18, 2025 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

The company was founded by Tomer Izraeli in January 2005 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.
info.description_zh: Polyrizon Ltd.是一家處於發展階段的生物技術公司，從事鼻腔水凝膠的開發。它為生物攻擊提供了屏障，包括新型冠狀病毒、流感、過敏原和其他空氣傳播的病原體與鼻上皮組織的相互作用。該公司由 Tomer Izraeli 於 2005 年 1 月創立，總部位於以色列 Raanana。

info.description: GoPro, Inc. engages in manufacturing and selling cameras and camera accessories. It provides mountable and wearable cameras and accessories, which it refers to as capture devices. Its product brands include HERO9 Black, HERO8 Black, Max, HERO7 Black, HERO7 Silver, GoPro Plus, and GoPro App. The company was founded by Nicholas Woodman in 2002 and is headquartered in San Mateo, CA.

info.description: Gelteq Ltd. operates as a biotechnology company. It focuses on the development and commercialization of white label gel-based delivery solutions for prescription drugs, nutraceuticals, pet care, and other products. The firm also offers edible gels. The company was founded by Nathan J. Givoni and Simon H. Szewach on October 15, 2018 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: Gelteq Ltd. 是一家生技公司。它專注於處方藥、營養保健品、寵物護理和其他產品的基於白標凝膠的輸送解決方案的開發和商業化。該公司還提供可食用凝膠。該公司由 Nathan J. Givoni 和 Simon H. Szewach 於 2018 年 10 月 15 日創立，總部位於澳洲墨爾本。

info.description: Draganfly, Inc. is a leader in cutting-edge drone solutions and software that are transforming industries and serving stakeholders globally. Its products include quad-copters, fixed wing aircrafts, ground based robots, hand held controllers, and software used for tracking, live streaming, and data collection. The firm also offers custom engineering, training, simulation consulting, as well as data and flight training services. The company was founded by Zenon Dragan and Christine Dragan in 1998 and is headquartered in Saskatoon, Canada.
info.description_zh: Draganfly, Inc. 是尖端無人機解決方案和軟體領域的領導者，致力於改變行業並為全球利益相關者提供服務。其產品包括四軸飛行器、固定翼飛機、地面機器人、手持控制器以及用於追蹤、直播和數據收集的軟體。該公司還提供客製化工程、培訓、模擬諮詢以及數據和飛行培訓服務。該公司由 Zenon Dragan 和 Christine Dragan 於 1998 年創立，總部位於加拿大薩斯卡通。

info.description: Conduent, Inc. delivers digital business solutions and services spanning the commercial, government and transportation spectrum creating valuable outcomes for clients and the millions of people who count on them. The cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, automation and advanced analytics deliver mission-critical solutions. It operates through the following segments: Commercial Industries, Government Services, and Transportation. The Commercial Industries segment offers business process services and customized solutions to clients in a variety of industries. The Government Services segment is involved in government-centric business process services and subject matter experts to U.S. federal, state, and local and foreign governments. The Transportation segment includes systems and support to transportation departments and agencies globally. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Florham Park, NJ.

The Pocono Pharmaceuticals segment relates to a coated products manufacturing entity. The 4P Therapeutics segment performs contract research and development services. The company was founded by Gareth R. Sheridan and Serguei Melnik in 2012 and is headquartered in Orlando, FL.
info.description_zh: Nutriband, Inc. 從事透皮醫藥產品組合的開發。它透過 Pocono Pharmaceuticals 和 4P Therapeutics 部門運作。 Pocono Pharmaceuticals 部門涉及塗層產品製造實體。 4P Therapeutics 部門提供合約研究和開發服務。該公司由 Gareth R. Sheridan 和 Serguei Melnik 於 2012 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州奧蘭多。

info.description: Linkhome Holdings, Inc. is an artificial intelligence-driven real estate technology company, which engages in the provision of mobile application for the buying and selling of properties. It also focuses on real estate solutions and services including real estate brokerage services, cash offer, property rental management, and home renovation. The company was founded by Zhen Qin and Na Li in July 2017 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
info.description_zh: Linkhome Holdings, Inc.是一家人工智慧驅動的房地產科技公司，致力於提供房產買賣的行動應用程式。它還專注於房地產解決方案和服務，包括房地產經紀服務、現金報價、物業租賃管理和家居裝修。該公司由秦臻和李娜於2017年7月創立，總部位於加州爾灣。

info.description: MMTec, Inc. engages in holding an equity interest in MM Future. It operates through the Gujia, MM Future and HC Securities, and MM Global segments. The Gujia, MM Future and HC Securities segment provides market data and consulting services. The MM Global segment introduces brokers that clear all transactions through clearing broker-dealers and earns commission income, placement agent service fees, and other related income from customers. The company was founded on January 4, 2018 and is headquartered in Hong Kong.
info.description_zh: MMTec, Inc. 持有 MM Future 的股權。它透過顧家、MM Future 和 HC Securities 以及 MM Global 部門進行運作。顧家、MM期貨和慧聰證券部門提供市場數據和諮詢服務。 MM Global部門引進經紀商，透過清算經紀交易商清算所有交易，並從客戶那裡賺取佣金收入、配售代理服務費和其他相關收入。該公司成立於2018年1月4日，總部位於香港。

info.description: Cresud SA engages in the production of basic agricultural commodities. It operates through the Agricultural Business, and Urban Properties and Investment Business segments. The Agricultural Business segment engages in the operation of crop production, cattle feeding, raising, fattening and slaughtering, milk production, sugarcane production, brokerage activities, and sale of supplies. The Urban and Investment Business segment comprises of Operation Center in Argentina, which includes shopping malls, offices, sales and development, hotels, international operations, entertainment activities, and corporate activities, and Operation Center in Israel, which consists of real estate, supermarkets, telecommunications, insurance, other diverse business, and holding companies activities. The company was founded on December 31, 1936 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
info.description_zh: Cresud SA 從事基本農產品的生產。它透過農業業務、城市房地產和投資業務部門運作。農業業務部門從事農作物生產、牛隻飼養、飼養、育肥及屠宰、牛奶生產、甘蔗生產、經紀活動及物資銷售等業務。城市與投資業務部門包括阿根廷營運中心（包括購物中心、辦公大樓、銷售和開發、酒店、國際營運、娛樂活動和企業活動）和以色列營運中心（包括房地產、超市、電信、保險、其他多元化業務和控股公司活動）。該公司成立於1936年12月31日，總部位於阿根廷布宜諾斯艾利斯。

info.description: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF seeks current income; exposure to the performance of one or more exchange-traded funds whose shares trade on a U.S.-regulated securities exchange and that seek daily leverage investment results of 2 times (200%) the daily percentage of the common stock of Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A (NASDAQ: META) subject to a limit on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying META ETF as the reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Graniteshares YieldBOOST Meta ETF 尋求當前收入；暴露於一隻或多只交易所交易基金的表現，這些基金的股票在美國監管的證券交易所進行交易，並且尋求每日槓桿投資結果為 Meta Platforms, Inc. A 類（納斯達克股票代碼：META）普通每日百分比的 2 倍（200%），但受到潛在投資收益股票的限制。該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於利用基礎 META ETF 作為參考資產的衍生性合約。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: MKAM ETF seeks to capture the majority of equity market returns, while exposing investors to less volatility and downside risk than other equity investments. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF") that seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in U.S. equity securities that generally mimic the performance of the S&P 500 Index while attempting to reduce volatility and mitigate drawdowns. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: MKAM ETF 旨在獲取大部分股票市場回報，同時使投資者面臨比其他股票投資更少的波動性和下行風險。該基金是一檔主動管理的交易所交易基金（「ETF」），旨在透過投資通常模仿標準普爾 500 指數表現的美國股票證券來實現其投資目標，同時試圖減少波動性和減少回撤。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Ascendis Pharma A/S is a biopharmaceutical company, which engages in the development of drug candidates. It specializes in its TransCon technologies to develop new therapies that address unmet medical needs. The company was founded by Jan Moller Mikkelsen, Dirk Vetter, and Harald Rau on September 21, 2006 and is headquartered in Hellerup, Denmark.
info.description_zh: Ascendis Pharma A/S 是一家生物製藥公司，從事候選藥物的開發。它專注於 TransCon 技術來開發新療法，以滿足未滿足的醫療需求。該公司由 Jan Moller Mikkelsen、Dirk Vetter 和 Harald Rau 於 2006 年 9 月 21 日創立，總部位於丹麥海勒魯普。

info.description: Themes US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions ETF seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the Solactive US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions Index. The index is a free-float adjusted, market capitalization weighted index that is designed to provide exposure to small capitalization U.S. companies that have a high cash flow yield. The fund will invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes, in the securities that comprise the index. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 主題 US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions ETF 旨在追蹤 Solactive US Small Cap Cash Flow Champions Index 扣除費用和開支之前的表現。該指數是一個自由流通量調整後的市值加權指數，旨在為現金流收益率較高的美國小市值公司提供投資機會。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產以及用於投資目的的任何借款金額投資於構成該指數的證券。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Man Active Trend Enhanced ETF seeks to provide capital growth. The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in two complementary investment strategies: an active, trend-following strategy (the "Trend-Following Strategy") and an equity strategy (the "Equity Strategy"). AHL Partners LLP, the fund's sub-adviser (the "Sub-Adviser"), employs a quantitative model to identify investment opportunities across a wide range of global markets. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Man Active Trend 增強型 ETF 旨在提供資本成長。該基金尋求透過投資兩種互補的投資策略來實現其投資目標：積極的趨勢追蹤策略（「趨勢追蹤策略」）和股票策略（「股票策略」）。該基金的副顧問（「副顧問」）AHL Partners LLP 採用定量模型來識別全球廣泛市場的投資機會。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Galaxy Digital, Inc. engages in digital assets and data center infrastructure, delivering solutions that accelerate progress in finance and artificial intelligence. It operates through the following segments: Digital Assets, Data Centers, and Treasury and Corporate. The digital assets segment offers institutional access to trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization technology. The Data Centers segment competes with a range of infrastructure providers that are building or repurposing facilities to support the rapidly growing demand for AI and compute-intensive workloads. The Treasury and Corporate segment includes the company's proprietary trading and mining activities, as well as the company's principal investments and related gains and losses. The company was founded by Michael Novogratz in 2018 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Galaxy Digital, Inc. 從事數位資產和資料中心基礎設施業務，提供可加速金融和人工智慧進步的解決方案。它透過以下部門運作：數位資產、資料中心、財務和企業部門。數位資產領域為機構提供交易、諮詢、資產管理、質押、自我託管和代幣化技術的存取權。資料中心部門與一系列基礎設施供應商競爭，這些供應商正在建造或重新利用設施，以支援對人工智慧和運算密集型工作負載快速成長的需求。財務和公司部門包括公司的自營交易和採礦活動，以及公司的主要投資和相關損益。該公司由 Michael Novogratz 於 2018 年創立，總部位於紐約州紐約市。

info.description: Leverage Shares 2X Long GLXY Daily ETF seeks daily levered investment results, before fees and expenses, of two times (200%) of the daily percentage change in the price of the common stock of GLXY. The fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments with economic characteristics that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to the price of GLXY, consistent with the fund's investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Afya Ltd. is a medical education group, which engages in the provision of an end-to-end physician-centric ecosystem that serves and empowers students to be lifelong medical learners through their medical residency preparation, post-graduate programs, and continuing medical education activities. It operates through Education Services; and Digital Content, Residency Preparatory and Specialization Programs segments. The Education Services segment provides educational services through undergraduate and graduate courses related to medicine, other health sciences, and other undergraduate programs. The Residency Preparatory and Specialization Programs segment offers digital and printed medical content services, including online courses for residency preparatory, medical and other than medical post-graduate specialization programs and mobile app subscription for digital medical content. The company was founded on March 22, 2019 and is headquartered in Nova Lima, Brazil.

info.description_zh: Fly-E Group, Inc.是一家電動車公司，以Fly E-Bike品牌從事設計、安裝和銷售智慧電動摩托車、電動自行車、電動滑板車及相關配件。其產品包括電動滑板車、電動自行車、零件和配件。該公司由周歐於2018年創立，總部位於紐約法拉盛。

info.description: SunPower, Inc. engages in providing residential solar and energy services. It provides a technology-enabled platform that supports a national network of sales partners, dealers, and installation professionals in delivering solar energy systems, battery storage solutions, and related services to homeowners and homebuilders throughout the United States. The company operates through the following segments: Residential Solar Installation, New Homes Business, and Dealer. The Residential Solar Installation segment engages in the sale, installation, monitoring, and maintenance of residential solar energy systems and energy storage solutions. The New Homes Business segment engages in providing solar energy systems and related services to homebuilders for incorporation into newly constructed homes. The Dealer segment engages in supporting a network of independent dealers through the sale of solar products, financing solutions, and related services for residential customers. The company was founded by William J. Anderson in 2010 and is headquartered in Orem, UT.
info.description_zh: SunPower, Inc. 從事提供住宅太陽能和能源服務。它提供了一個技術支援的平台，支援全國銷售合作夥伴、經銷商和安裝專業人員網絡，為美國各地的房主和住宅建築商提供太陽能係統、電池儲存解決方案和相關服務。該公司透過以下部門營運：住宅太陽能安裝部門、新房業務部門和經銷商部門。住宅太陽能安裝部門從事住宅太陽能係統和儲能解決方案的銷售、安裝、監控和維護。新住宅業務部門致力於為住宅建築商提供太陽能係統和相關服務，以納入新建住宅。經銷商部門透過向住宅客戶銷售太陽能產品、融資解決方案和相關服務來支援獨立經銷商網路。該公司由 William J. Anderson 於 2010 年創立，總部位於猶他州奧勒姆。

info.description: Australian Oilseeds Holdings Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale oil seeds through its subsidiaries. It focuses on acquiring, engaging in a share exchange, share reconstruction, and amalgamation with, purchasing all or substantially all the assets of, entering contractual arrangements with, or engaging in any other similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on December 29, 2022 and is headquartered in Cootamundra, Australia.
info.description_zh: 澳洲油籽控股有限公司透過其子公司從事油籽生產和銷售。它的重點是收購一個或多個企業或實體、進行股份交換、股份重組、合併、購買其全部或幾乎所有資產、與其簽訂合約安排或進行任何其他類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2022年12月29日，總部位於澳洲庫塔曼德拉。

info.description: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. is a holding company, which engages in the manufacture and sales of stainless steel band, copper strip, welded stainless steel pipes and fittings, valve, light industry machinery equipment, and other stainless steel products. The company was founded by Jian Cong Huang and Guo Lin Wang on May 13, 2015 and is headquartered in Wenzhou, China.
info.description_zh: 中康國際集團有限公司是一家控股公司，主要從事不銹鋼帶、銅帶、不銹鋼焊接管材及管件、閥門、輕工業機械設備等不銹鋼產品的製造和銷售。該公司由黃健聰和王果林於2015年5月13日創立，總部位於中國溫州。

info.description: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. engages in the development and commercialization of drugs for gastrointestinal (GI), infectious diseases, and oncology. The firm's products include Talicia, Movantik, and Aemcolo. It operates through the Commercial Operations and Research and Development segments. The Commercial Operations segment covers areas relating to commercial sales through a subsidiary in the United States. The Research and Development segment includes the study and licensing of therapeutic candidates. The company was founded by Dror Ben-Asher and Ori Shilo on August 3, 2009 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.
info.industry_zh: 藥品製造商 - 特用藥品和非專利藥品
info.description_zh: RedHill Biopharma Ltd. 從事胃腸道 (GI)、傳染病和腫瘤學藥物的開發和商業化。該公司的產品包括 Talicia、Movantik 和 Aemcolo。它透過商業營運和研發部門進行運作。商業營運部門涵蓋與透過美國子公司進行商業銷售相關的領域。研究與開發部門包括候選治療藥物的研究和許可。該公司由 Dror Ben-Asher 和 Ori Shilo 於 2009 年 8 月 3 日創立，總部位於以色列特拉維夫。

info.description: One & One Green Technologies, Inc. engages in the recycling, production, and trading of recycled scrap metals. Its products include copper alloy ingot, recycled aluminum, recycled tin, recycled zinc, recycled iron, and plastic beads. The company was founded on April 17, 2024 and is headquartered in Bulacan, Philippines.
info.description_zh: One & One Green Technologies, Inc. 從事再生廢金屬的回收、生產和貿易。其產品包括銅合金錠、再生鋁、再生錫、再生鋅、再生鐵和塑膠珠。該公司成立於2024年4月17日，總部位於菲律賓布拉幹省。

info.description: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. is a self-managed real estate investment trust, which invests in a diverse multi-tenant portfolio of real estate assets. It operates through the following segments: Office and Industrial Properties, Model Home Properties, and Retail Properties. The Office and Industrial Properties segment consists of office buildings and an industrial property leased to a variety of tenants ranging from small businesses to large public companies. The Model Home Properties segment consists of model home residential properties leased to homebuilders. The Retail Properties segment includes shopping centers. The company was founded by Jack Kendrick Heilbron on September 28, 1999 and is headquartered in San Diego, CA.
info.industry_zh: 房地產投資信託基金 - 多元化
info.description_zh: Presidio Property Trust, Inc. 是一家自我管理的房地產投資信託公司，投資於多元化的多租戶房地產資產組合。它透過以下部門運作：辦公室和工業地產、樣板房地產和零售地產。辦公和工業地產部門包括辦公大樓和工業地產，租賃給從小型企業到大型上市公司等各種租戶。樣品屋物業部門包括出租給房屋建築商的樣品屋住宅物業。零售物業部門包括購物中心。該公司由 Jack Kendrick Heilbron 於 1999 年 9 月 28 日創立，總部位於加州聖地牙哥。

info.description: Sono Group NV engages in the provision of solar-powered mobility applications. It operates through the Finland and Germany geographical segments. The company was founded by Laurin Hahn, Navina Persteiner and Jona Christians in 2012 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.
info.description_zh: Sono Group NV 致力於提供太陽能行動應用。它透過芬蘭和德國地理部門運作。該公司由 Laurin Hahn、Navina Persteiner 和 Jona Christians 於 2012 年創立，總部位於德國慕尼黑。

info.description: Nocera, Inc. is a holding company, which through its subsidiary engages in the aquaculture consulting and management business. Its services include design, install, build, and manage aquaculture investment and projects; pilot and management services to aquaculture companies and new aquaculture projects; and offers equipment and materials from suppliers. The company was founded on February 1, 2002 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: Nocera, Inc.是一家控股公司，透過其子公司從事水產養殖諮詢和管理業務。其服務包括設計、安裝、建造和管理水產養殖投資和專案；為水產養殖公司和新水產養殖專案提供試點和管理服務；並提供來自供應商的設備和材料。公司成立於2002年2月1日，總部位於台灣新北市。

info.description: Titan Machinery, Inc. engages in the management of agricultural and construction equipment stores. It operates through the following segments: Agriculture, Construction, Europe, and Australian. The Agriculture segment sells services and rents machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from large-scale farming to home and garden use in North America. The Construction segment focuses on machinery and related parts and attachments, for uses from heavy construction to light industrial machinery. The Europe segment manages ancillary sales and services related to agricultural activities and products in Eastern Europe and Germany. The Australian segments offer products such as equipment transportation, GPS signal subscriptions, and finance and insurance products in Southeastern Australia. The company was founded by David Joseph Meyer in 1980 and is headquartered in West Fargo, ND.
info.description_zh: Titan Machinery, Inc. 從事農業和建築設備商店的管理。它透過以下部門運作：農業、建築、歐洲和澳洲。農業部門銷售服務並租賃機械及相關零件和配件，用於北美的大規模農業以及家庭和花園用途。建築部門專注於機械及相關零件和附件，適用於從重型建築到輕工業機械的用途。歐洲部門管理與東歐和德國農業活動和產品相關的輔助銷售和服務。澳洲分部在澳洲東南部提供設備運輸、GPS 訊號訂閱以及金融和保險產品等產品。該公司由 David Joseph Meyer 於 1980 年創立，總部位於北達科他州西法戈。

info.description: Limbach Holdings, Inc. engages in the provision of commercial specialty contractor services in the areas of heating, ventilation, air-conditioning, plumbing, electrical and building controls for the design and construction of new and renovated buildings, maintenance services, energy retrofits, and equipment upgrades. It operates through the General Contractor Relationships and Owner Direct Relationships segments. The General Contractor Relationships segment manages new construction or renovation projects that involve primarily HVAC, plumbing, or electrical services. The Owner Direct Relationships segment provides maintenance or services primarily on HVAC, plumbing or electrical systems, building controls and specialty contracting projects. The company was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Tampa, FL.

The firm develops sulfide-based solid-electrolyte material technology that replaces the liquid or gel electrolyte used in traditional lithium-ion battery cells. It focuses on the development and commercialization of all-solid-state battery cells and solid-electrolyte materials, primarily for the battery-powered electric vehicle market. The company was founded on August 3, 2011 and is headquartered in Louisville, CO.

info.description: GraniteShares YieldBOOST SMCI ETF seeks to achieve 2 times (200%) the income generated from selling options on Super Micro Computer Inc.'s common stock by selling options on leveraged exchange-traded funds designed to deliver 2 times (200%) the daily performance of the Underlying Stock and to gain exposure to the performance of the Underlying Leveraged ETF, subject to a cap on potential investment gains. The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets in derivatives contracts that utilize the Underlying Leveraged ETF as their reference asset. The fund is non-diversified.

info.description: Hotchkis & Wiley SMID Cap Diversified Value Fund seeks capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities of small to mid capitalization companies the fund's advisor believes to be undervalued. The equity securities in which the fund may invest include common and preferred stocks. The fund may invest in foreign (non-U.S.) securities.

info.description: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 28, 2023 and is headquartered in Danville, CA.
info.description_zh: Black Hawk Acquisition Corp. 作為一家空白支票公司運營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2023年9月28日，總部位於加州丹維爾。

info.description: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. engages in the development of therapeutic products and medical therapies using cell and tissue protocols. Its programs provide quality of care for chronic back pain caused by disc degeneration and metabolic disorders, including obesity and diabetes. The company's initial investigational therapeutic product being called BRTX-100 focuses on treating damage by an autologous stem cell product that uses own stem cells that are harvested, cultured, and then injected directly into the affected disc to start the repair process. BioRestorative Therapies was founded on June 13, 1997 and is headquartered in Melville, NY.
info.description_zh: BioRestorative Therapies, Inc. 從事利用細胞和組織方案開發治療產品和醫學療法。其項目為椎間盤退化和代謝紊亂（包括肥胖和糖尿病）引起的慢性背痛提供優質護理。該公司最初的研究性治療產品名為 BRTX-100，專注於透過自體幹細胞產品治療損傷，該產品使用收穫、培養的自體幹細胞，然後直接注射到受影響的椎間盤中以啟動修復過程。 BioRestorative Therapies 成立於 1997 年 6 月 13 日，總部位於紐約州梅爾維爾。

info.description: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an index called the Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM Index (the "index"). Under normal conditions, the fund will invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the equity securities that comprise the index. The index is a rules-based equity index designed to track the overall performance of the 50 most undervalued stocks comprising the NASDAQ US Large Mid Cap Index TM that exhibit high levels of "relative strength."
info.description_zh: First Trust Dorsey Wright Momentum & Value ETF 尋求與稱為 Dorsey Wright Momentum Plus Value TM 指數（「指數」）的指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應的投資結果。在正常情況下，基金將至少90%的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的股本證券。該指數是一個基於規則的股票指數，旨在追蹤納斯達克美國大中型股指數 TM 中最被低估的 50 隻股票的整體表現，這些股票表現出高水平的「相對強度」。

info.description: GT Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of the immuno-oncology therapeutic products based proprietary TriKE NK cell engager platform. The TriKE platform is designed to harness and enhance the cancer killing abilities of a patient's immune system natural killer cells (NK cells). Its product, GTB-3550, is initially developed for the treatment of AML and MDS, and other CD33+ hematologic cancers. GT Biopharma has a worldwide license agreement with the University of Minnesota to further develop and commercialize therapies using TriKE technology. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
info.description_zh: GT Biopharma, Inc. 是一家臨床階段生物製藥公司，專注於基於專有 TriKE NK 細胞接合器平台的免疫腫瘤治療產品的開發和商業化。 TriKE 平台旨在利用和增強患者免疫系統自然殺手細胞（NK 細胞）的殺傷能力。其產品GTB-3550最初是為治療AML和MDS以及其他CD33+血液癌症而開發的。 GT Biopharma 與明尼蘇達大學簽訂了全球授權協議，以進一步開發和商業化使用 TriKE 技術的療法。該公司成立於 1965 年，總部位於加州舊金山。

info.description: Fusion Fuel Green Plc engages in the research and development of solar technologies. It develops a process and technology to produce emission-free green hydrogen using concentrated photovoltaic technology. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland.
info.industry_zh: 公用事業 - 再生能源
info.description_zh: Fusion Fuel Green Plc 從事太陽能技術的研究和開發。它開發了一種利用聚光光伏技術生產無排放綠色氫的製程和技術。該公司成立於2018年，總部位於愛爾蘭都柏林。

info.description: Karbon Capital Partners Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded in 2025 and is headquartered in Scranton, PA.
info.description_zh: Karbon Capital Partners Corp. 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年，總部位於賓夕法尼亞州斯克蘭頓。

info.description: Katapult Holdings, Inc. is an e-commerce focused financial technology company. The firm is engaged in the provision of e-commerce point-of-sale lease-purchase options for nonprime U.S. consumers. It offers its customers a lease purchase transaction processing system with no long-term obligation and options for ownership. The company was founded in August 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, TX.
info.description_zh: Katapult Holdings, Inc. 是一家專注於電子商務的金融科技公司。該公司致力於為美國非優質消費者提供電子商務銷售點租賃購買選擇。它為客戶提供租賃購買交易處理系統，沒有長期義務和所有權選擇。該公司成立於 2019 年 8 月，總部位於德克薩斯州普萊諾。

info.description: La Rosa Holdings Corp. operates as a holding company, which provides real estate brokerage services. It sells technology-based products and services primarily to sales agents and the sales agents associated with its franchisees. The company operates through the five reportable segments: Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services, Franchising Services, Coaching Services, Property Management, and Commercial Real Estate Brokerage Services. The Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services segment engages in the real estate brokerage business. The Franchising Services segment engages in the franchising of real estate brokerage agencies. The Coaching Services segment engages in the delivery of coaching services to its brokers and franchisee's brokers. The Property Management segment engages in the training of its sales agents to provide residential property management services to owners of single family residential properties. The Commercial Real Estate Brokerage Services segment engages in the brokering of the sale of commercial real estate. La Rosa Holdings was founded by Joseph La Rosa in 2004 and is headquartered in Celebration, FL.

info.description_zh: La Rosa Holdings Corp. 作為一家控股公司經營，提供房地產經紀服務。它主要向銷售代理商和與其特許經營商相關的銷售代理商銷售基於技術的產品和服務。該公司透過五個可報告部門運營：住宅房地產經紀服務、特許經營服務、教練服務、物業管理和商業房地產經紀服務。住宅房地產經紀服務部門從事房地產經紀業務。特許經營服務部門從事房地產經紀機構的特許經營業務。教練服務部門為其經紀人和加盟商的經紀人提供教練服務。物業管理部門從事銷售代理的培訓，為單戶住宅物業的業主提供住宅物業管理服務。商業房地產經紀服務部門從事商業房地產銷售經紀業務。 La Rosa Holdings 由 Joseph La Rosa 於 2004 年創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州賽里布瑞恩。

info.description: New Providence Acquisition Corp. III is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on December 4, 2024 and is headquartered in Palm Beach, FL.
info.description_zh: New Providence Acquisition Corp. III 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2024 年 12 月 4 日，總部位於佛羅裡達州棕櫚灘。

info.description: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of NVDA. The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in the securities of NVDA and financial instruments, such as swap agreements and options, that provide leveraged exposure to NVDA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion Daily Nvda Bull 1.5X Shares 尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）為 NVDA 每日表現的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 NVDA 的證券以及為 NVDA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I is a blank check company, which engages in the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Anna Nahajski-Staples on August 19, 2025 and is headquartered in New York, NY.
info.description_zh: Paloma Acquisition Corp. I 是一家空白支票公司，其目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Anna Nahajski-Staples 於 2025 年 8 月 19 日創立，總部位於紐約州紐約。

info.description: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF is an actively managed strategy designed to generate real returns and provide a direct hedge against rising inflation while minimizing the interest rate volatility typically associated with long-duration inflation-protected securities. The fund invests primarily in a diversified portfolio of short-term U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) and inflation-linked derivatives, utilizing PIMCO's macroeconomic research to tactically manage inflation breakeven positioning and duration.
info.description_zh: PIMCO Inflation PLUS Active ETF 是一種主動管理策略，旨在產生實際回報並提供對通膨上升的直接對沖，同時最大限度地減少通常與長期通膨保值證券相關的利率波動。該基金主要投資於短期美國國債通膨保值證券（TIPS）和通膨掛鉤衍生性商品的多元化投資組合，利用太平洋投資管理公司的宏觀經濟研究來戰術性地管理通膨盈虧平衡頭寸和久期。

info.description: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund seeks investment results that correspond generally to the price and yield (before the fund's fees and expenses) of an equity index called the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index. The fund will normally invest at least 90% of its net assets (including investment borrowings) in the securities that comprise the index. The index is designed to track the performance of small, mid and large capitalization companies that comprise the community banking industry.
info.description_zh: First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund 尋求的投資結果通常與名為 NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank TM Index 的股票指數的價格和收益率（在基金費用和開支之前）相對應。該基金通常將至少 90% 的淨資產（包括投資借款）投資於構成該指數的證券。該指數旨在追蹤社區銀行業中小型、中型和大型資本公司的表現。

info.description: Scienjoy Holding Corp. provides mobile entertainment live streaming platforms in China. The firm operates its platforms on both PC and mobile apps, through which users can enjoy immersive and interactive entertainment live streaming. Its different platforms include broadcaster policy, events, promotion and games. The firm also provides technological infrastructure to enable broadcasters, online users, and viewers to interact with each other during live streaming. The company was founded by Xiao Wu He, Pei Lu & Bo Wan in October 2011 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
info.description_zh: Scienjoy Holding Corp. 在中國提供行動娛樂直播平台。該公司在PC和行動應用程式上經營其平台，用戶可以透過這些平台享受身臨其境的互動娛樂直播。其不同平台包括廣播公司政策、活動、促銷和遊戲。該公司還提供技術基礎設施，使廣播公司、線上用戶和觀眾能夠在直播過程中相互互動。該公司由何曉武、盧培和萬博於2011年10月創立，總部位於中國北京。

info.description: SUMA Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company, which was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded by Naseem Saloojee and David King on November 21, 2025 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
info.description_zh: SUMA Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司，其成立目的是與一個或多個企業或實體進行合併、合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似業務合併。該公司由 Naseem Saloojee 和 David King 於 2025 年 11 月 21 日創立，總部位於加拿大多倫多。

info.description: TNL Mediagene engages in digital advertising, integrated marketing, marketing survey, artificial intelligence technology, data analysis, content service platform, and production of audio-visual programs. It operates media, technology, and digital studio businesses primarily in Japan and Taiwan. The company was founded on May 25, 2023 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
info.description_zh: TNL Mediagene 從事數位廣告、整合行銷、行銷調查、人工智慧技術、數據分析、內容服務平台和視聽節目製作。該公司主要在日本和台灣經營媒體、科技和數位工作室業務。該公司成立於2023年5月25日，總部位於台灣台北。

info.description: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF seeks long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively-managed ETF that seeks to achieve its investment objective by utilizing an investment strategy that leverages artificial intelligence ("AI") and natural language processing to derive a proprietary News Media Sentiment Signal (the "Sentiment Signal"). Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amounts of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securities of U.S.-listed large, mid and small capitalization companies.
info.description_zh: Stocksnips AI-Powered Sentiment US ALL Cap ETF 尋求長期資本增值。該基金是一檔主動管理的 ETF，旨在透過利用人工智慧（「AI」）和自然語言處理來得出專有的新聞媒體情緒訊號（「情緒訊號」）的投資策略來實現其投資目標。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款金額）投資於美國上市的大、中、小型資本公司的證券。

info.description: LightWave Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on January 22, 2025 and is headquartered in Dallas, TX.
info.description_zh: LightWave Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年1月22日，總部位於德州達拉斯。

info.description: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company. It was created for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on September 29, 2025 and is headquartered in Miami, FL.
info.description_zh: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. 是一家空白支票公司。它的創建目的是為了實現與一個或多個企業的合併、聯合、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2025年9月29日，總部位於佛羅裡達州邁阿密。

info.description: Gesher Acquisition Corp. II operates as a blank check company. It was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, capital stock exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, reorganization, or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on August 30, 2024 and is headquartered in Denver, CO.
info.description_zh: Gesher Acquisition Corp. II 以空白支票公司經營。它的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股本交換、資產收購、股票購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於2024年8月30日，總部位於科羅拉多州丹佛市。

info.description: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII is a blank check company. The firm was formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was founded on July 15, 2025 and is headquartered in Zephyr Cove, NV.
info.description_zh: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VIII 是一家空白支票公司。該公司的成立目的是與一個或多個企業進行合併、股份交換、資產收購、股份購買、重組或類似的業務合併。該公司成立於 2025 年 7 月 15 日，總部位於內華達州 Zephyr Cove。

info.description: Parametric Equity Plus ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund ("ETF"). The investment objective of the fund is to seek to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in equity securities.
info.description_zh: 參數股票加ETF旨在提供長期資本增值。該基金為主動式管理型交易所交易基金（“ETF”）。該基金的投資目標是尋求提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金將至少80%的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於股本證券。

info.description: JPMorgan Fundamental Data Science Large Core ETF seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation. Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its assets in equity securities of large, well established companies. Many of the equity securities in the fund's portfolio will be technology companies or companies that rely heavily on technological advances. In managing the fund, the adviser employs a fundamental data science enabled investment approach that combines research, data insights, and risk management. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: 摩根大通基本資料科學大型核心 ETF 旨在提供長期資本增值。在正常情況下，該基金至少將其資產的 80% 投資於大型、成熟公司的股本證券。該基金投資組合中的許多股本證券將是科技公司或嚴重依賴技術進步的公司。在管理基金時，顧問採用了基礎數據科學支持的投資方法，結合了研究、數據洞察和風險管理。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF seeks to provide investment results that, before fees and expenses, correspond to the performance of the Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index. The fund implements its investment objective by investing, under normal market conditions, at least 80% of its net assets in financial instruments that achieve the investment results of the index. The index is a rules-based strategy that seeks to track the performance of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF, with investment exposure to the underlying ETF adjusted for a targeted annual volatility rate of 20%. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: WEBs Defined Volatility SPY ETF 力求提供扣除費用和開支先前與 Syntax Defined Volatility US Large Cap 500 Index 的表現相對應的投資結果。該基金透過在正常市場條件下將至少80%的淨資產投資於實現指數投資結果的金融工具來實現其投資目標。該指數是一種基於規則的策略，旨在追蹤 SPDR S&P 500 ETF 的表現，並根據 20% 的目標年度波動率調整基礎 ETF 的投資曝險。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund designed to provide comprehensive, uncapped exposure to the financials sector by utilizing a hybrid investment approach. The fund addresses the limitations of traditional market-cap-weighted sector indexes-which often underweight the largest constituents to maintain regulatory compliance-by combining direct equity investments with targeted sector ETFs to more accurately reflect the sector's true market-capitalization composition.
info.description_zh: VanEck Financials TruSector ETF 是一款主動管理的交易所交易基金，旨在透過利用混合投資方式提供全面、無上限的金融業投資。該基金透過將直接股權投資與目標產業 ETF 結合，解決了傳統市值加權產業指數的局限性（該指數通常會低估最大的成分股以維持監管合規性），以更準確地反映該行業的真實市值組成。

info.description: Kyivstar Group Ltd. engages in the telecommunications and digital business. It provides mobile, digital and fixed-line services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

info.description: Direxion Daily TSLA Bull 1.5X Shares seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 150% of the daily performance of TSLA. The fund is non-diversified.
info.description_zh: Direxion 每日 TSLA 牛市 1.5 倍股票尋求每日投資績效（未計費用和開支）達到 TSLA 每日業績的 150%。在正常情況下，該基金將至少 80% 的淨資產（加上任何用於投資目的的借款）投資於 TSLA 證券以及為 TSLA 提供槓桿敞口的金融工具，例如掉期協議和選擇權。該基金是非多元化的。

info.description: HCW Biologics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel immunotherapies to lengthen health span by disrupting the link between chronic, low-grade inflammation, and age-related diseases. The firm considers age-related low-grade chronic inflammation as a contributing factor to several chronic diseases and conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, neurodegenerative diseases, and autoimmune diseases. The company was founded by Hing C. Wong on April 2, 2018 and is headquartered in Miramar, FL.
info.description_zh: HCW Biologics Inc. 是一家生物製藥公司，專注於發現和開發新型免疫療法，透過破壞慢性、低度發炎和年齡相關疾病之間的關聯來延長健康壽命。該公司認為與年齡相關的低度慢性發炎是導致多種慢性疾病和病症的因素，例如癌症、心血管疾病、糖尿病、神經退化性疾病和自體免疫疾病。該公司由 Hing C. Wong 於 2018 年 4 月 2 日創立，總部位於佛羅裡達州米拉瑪。
